notifications.title: zinalog 0.3.2 is available
notifications.message: Zinalog v0.3.2 improves real-time log streaming reliability, and introduces a cleaner, more compact Logs toolbar. Upgrade with: docker pull ghcr.io/zinalog/zinalog:latest

notifications.message: Zinalog node just got an upgrade and moved to to new organisation on npm @zinalog/node. Follow the guides to upgrade
